mentions.name: ClipCut
mentions.description: A video file conversion tool with no payments, no login requirement, no ads, and no file uploads.
mentions.problem: Existing video conversion tools are either paid, require login, are full of ads, or upload the user's files.
mentions.audience: Frequent video converters looking for a no-friction alternative (the author built it for their own repeated need to convert video files).
mentions.source_excerpt:
I frequently found myself needing to convert video files and everything is either paid, needs login, full of ads, or uploads your files. So I built my own tool that has none of that.

https://clipcut.dev
mentions.author: kriz9
